title: What Actually Makes You Senior
summary: Argues that the core skill separating senior+ engineers from mid-level engineers is the ability to reduce ambiguity in fuzzy, complex problems through strategic questioning, risk mitigation, and problem clarification before execution.
when-to-read: Read this when you're trying to understand what distinguishes experienced engineers from competent ones, or when you want to assess your own readiness for senior-level responsibility. If you're looking for specific technical competencies or architectural patterns instead, consult software-architecture resources; this article focuses on the meta-skill that amplifies all other engineering abilities.
